factual_flags: The article mentions 'The number of Indians studying abroad fell 6.1% in 2025' and then later 'SEVIS data shared with India's Rajya Sabha showed Indian students in American institutions fell from 378,787 in February 2025 to 352,644 in February 2026'. The article states 'US F-1 visas for Indian students dropped 69% in peak months of 2025'. Again, 2025 is in the future. This date needs to be verified and corrected.
suggestions: Correct the future-dated years (2025, 2026) to reflect actual past or current data, as this significantly impacts the factual accuracy.
Consider adding a quote from an Indian student who chose a non-US destination to personalize the 'reroute' narrative.
